trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this platinum unlocks on its own; there is no separate task behind it. Treat the four roadmap stages as the plan — story first, then stranger strands, then activities and robberies, then the clean-up to 100% — and this is the last trophy to pop. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and the trophy unlocks as the mission ends. It is story progress, so it cannot be missed — keep playing the main missions and it comes to you. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Chapter trophies follow the story and cannot be missed, so there is nothing to prepare — just finish the chapter's missions in order. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies it is tied to story progress alone and cannot be missed — keep working through the main missions in order. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Chapter trophies cannot be missed, so if you are chasing the platinum efficiently, save the big collectible hunts for stage 4 and focus on the story here. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end; the trophy pops when the chapter closes, leaving only the final mission. There is no preparation to do — chapter trophies are unmissable story-progress trophies — just complete the main missions. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission and this gold trophy unlocks — it cannot be missed, since finishing the story is the requirement. Before you start it, clear the one-shot story moments on the Missables page, since the story ends here. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run; the trophy pops at its end. It is flagged as a one-shot moment because the mission only happens once in the story — if it somehow does not pop, replay the mission if the game offers mission replay. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist; the trophy pops when it ends. It is a one-shot story moment — the heist happens once — so play the mission through during the story, and use mission replay if the game offers it and you need to recover it. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play; the trophy pops at its end. A one-shot story moment: the mission happens once, so finish it during the story, and replay it via mission replay if that option exists and you somehow miss it. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners; the trophy pops when it ends. It is tied to a single story mission, so it is flagged as a one-shot moment — play the mission through during the story, and use mission replay to recover it if the game offers that option. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport; the trophy pops at its end. A one-shot story moment — the takedown happens once — so finish the mission during the story and replay it via mission replay if you need to. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory; the trophy pops when it ends. Flagged as a one-shot moment because the operation happens once in the story — play it through, and use mission replay if the game offers it and the trophy does not pop. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — PSN counts it 0 to 100 — and this gold trophy pops. It is the last big gate before the platinum because 100% folds in the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles; check the in-game completion tracker to see what is still missing. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/100).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — PSN counts 0 to 250. Stunts build up across free roam (jumps, airtime, near-misses), so drive boldly and let the counter climb while you work on other trophies; it needs no special setup. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/250).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — PSN counts 0 to 9. The description does not name the 9 types, so sample everything the game offers — races, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, bowling, the arcade and more — and the trophy pops when the ninth type registers. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/9).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — PSN counts 0 to 42. This is the hardest grind on the list: practise each challenge until the gold score feels comfortable, work range by range, and leave it for stage 3 when you are warmed up. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/42).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — PSN counts 0 to 14. Learn a course's line before racing to win; a loss costs only a retry. The description does not name the locations, so work through every drone-race spot you find. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/14).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — PSN counts 0 to 20. 'Different' matters: winning the same race twice counts once, so spread wins across race types and places and pick a quick, well-tuned vehicle. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/20).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is a timing game — hook, reel steadily, keep the line from snapping — so practise at an ordinary spot first if the challenge feels tight; it is not missable, so you can retry. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and finish one arcade game. Any game counts, so choose the shortest one first — a quick pick while sampling activities for Master of None. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's strand through to its final mission and finish it. Strands open as the story moves on and stay open afterwards, so check back with Andy between main missions and wrap the strand up in stage 2. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's strand through to its final mission and finish it. Like the other character strands, it opens during the story and stays available afterwards, so there is no rush — just return to Kenton whenever his marker appears. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's strand through to its final mission and finish it. The strand opens during the story and remains open after it, so finish it in stage 2 of the roadmap alongside the other character strands — no special preparation needed. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — PSN counts 0 to 8. Strangers appear as you explore, each with a short strand; the five named character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward the eight, so finish those first and pick up three more. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/8).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's strand through to its final mission and finish it. Strands open during the story and stay available afterwards, so work it in stage 2 with the other character strands — return whenever Randy's marker shows up. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's strand through to its final mission and finish it. As with the other character strands it opens during the story and remains open after it, so there is no deadline — finish it in stage 2 alongside the rest. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — PSN counts 0 to 18. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places; visit them while exploring for The Goodtime State so the two trophies advance together, and tick each spot off as you go. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/18).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Follow Bret's strand and its clues, bring a good rifle, and take a clean shot when the animal shows itself. The description names no species or place, so let Bret's missions lead you. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets — PSN counts 0 to 3. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect them while exploring and finish one set at a time, hunting the missing cards set by set. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/3).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations — PSN counts 0 to 100. 'Different' is the point: the same spot twice counts once, so use it whenever you reach somewhere new rather than farming one place. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/100).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind — PSN counts 0 to 50. Challenges are the small goals layered over play (stunts, races, shooting and more), so this fills itself in as you work the rest of the list; check the challenge menu if it stalls. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/50).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then shake the cops and escape. Flagged as a one-shot setup because it needs your partner present and a clean escape: get your partner in the car first, cause enough trouble to reach four stars, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the chain breaks if the heat drops between shops. Flagged as a one-shot setup: plan a route of three close shops, keep the getaway car running, and move fast from one to the next. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — PSN counts 0 to 100. Any vehicle you climb into for the first time counts, so try everything from scooters to trucks as you travel; register the keepers with the Scooter Bros app for On the Spot. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/100).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Set it up on purpose: find a cluster of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns quickly — a quiet street with two enemies will not do it. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — take a plane out without following the normal departure. Flagged as a one-shot setup because it needs an aircraft at the airport and a quick getaway; grab a plane on the tarmac and leave before security closes in. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not an instruction — it names no method or count, and this guide invents none. What is known: it is tied to Rhino tanks, which show up at high wanted levels and around military spots — and PSN shows no progress counter for it, so there is no count to grind toward. It is flagged as a one-shot setup to attempt deliberately when a Rhino appears. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Flagged as a one-shot setup: go in quiet, stay out of cameras and guards' sightlines, take the goods and leave before any alarm — being spotted fails the attempt, so restart it clean. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — PSN counts 0 to 5. Vaults are the big robberies: plan the entry, grab the cash and have the getaway ready before the alarm brings the heat; each vault counts separately. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/5).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck, rob it and escape. Trucks run routes around Leonida — watch for one, hit it, grab the cash and break away before the cops box you in; a fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — PSN counts 0 to 52. Drive, fly and sail everywhere — cities, swamps, beaches and backroads all count — so cover the map in a sweep and check the in-game progress to find the areas you have missed. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/52).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — PSN counts 0 to 9. Each gang runs its own operations around Leonida, so you must hit all nine rather than farming one gang's spots; work through them gang by gang. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/9).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. Flagged as a one-shot moment because it is one specific scenic interaction: sit at the beachfront spot with a drink and let the scene play out. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass and out the other side — the classic showroom smash. Flagged as a one-shot setup: pick a showroom, line up a fast car outside and drive through the front; if it does not pop, try another showroom. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and finish a game with a proper follow-through. Flagged as a one-shot moment because it is tied to that one alley: find the Kolt & Associates alley, bowl a full game and mind the follow-through. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — 'a partnership with mass appeal' — and names no method, so this guide invents none. It is most likely a hidden story or partnership moment; it is flagged as a one-shot moment, so play the story with your partner and watch for a moment that fits the name. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices — PSN counts 0 to 500. Choices are the small decisions layered through play (dialogue picks, activity choices and the like), so this fills in naturally over a full playthrough; do not grind it, just keep playing and deciding. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/500).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt — the name says it: fail something once, then pass it on the next try. The surest way is to fail a retryable activity (a race, a challenge, a mission checkpoint) and then pass it immediately after. Flagged as a one-shot setup because the fail-then-pass pair has to happen in order. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the list's oddball moment trophy, most likely a random world event or an easter egg. Flagged as a one-shot moment because strange encounters are situational: explore Leonida, chase the odd and the out-of-place, and keep an eye out while doing other trophies. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and bowl the target over. Flagged as a one-shot setup: you need a slow-moving vehicle, a melee weapon equipped and a pedestrian target; line it up at low speed. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts — PSN counts 0 to 250,000. Marked Bills come from robberies (bank vaults, armored trucks, illegal operations), and contacts clean them for a cut; keep robbing and laundering until the counter clears. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/250000).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — PSN counts 0 to 100,000. It fills in by playing normally (weapons, clothes, cars, food), so do not force it early; by the time you have bought the garages for Little Boxes and the gear for the rest of the list, it will be close. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/100000).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties — PSN counts 0 to 8. Garages cost in-game money, so save up during stages 3 and 4 (the laundering from Dime on the Dollar helps) and buy each one as you can afford it. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/8).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app — PSN counts 0 to 10. As you discover vehicles for Whip It Good, open the Scooter Bros app and register the ones worth keeping; ten registrations is a small slice of the hundred. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target 0/10).
